name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Direct income support scheme providing Rs. 6000 per year to small and marginal farmer families, paid in three installments.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act Scheme
description: Guarantees 100 days of wage employment per year to rural households whose adult members volunteer for unskilled manual work.

name: Ayushman Bharat
description: Health insurance scheme providing coverage up to Rs. 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization.
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
description: Provides free LPG gas connections to women from below-poverty-line households to reduce reliance on unclean cooking fuels.
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas

name: Swachh Bharat Mission
description: Nationwide campaign to eliminate open defecation and improve solid waste management through sanitation infrastructure.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
description: Financial inclusion scheme providing access to bank accounts, credit, insurance, and pension for unbanked citizens.

name: Digital India
description: Flagship program to transform India into a digitally empowered society through improved online infrastructure and digital literacy.
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

name: Startup India
description: Initiative to promote entrepreneurship through funding support, tax exemptions, and simplified compliance for startups.

name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao
description: Campaign to address declining child sex ratio and promote education and welfare of the girl child.
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana
description: Scheme aiming to provide affordable pucca housing to urban and rural poor by offering subsidies on home loans.
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

name: Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyan
description: Economic stimulus and policy package aimed at making India self-reliant through domestic manufacturing and reforms.

name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme
description: Offers financial incentives to boost domestic manufacturing and attract investment across key sectors like electronics and pharma.
